out_items.name: Proper eating, tasting, drinking, or tobacco use

violations.title: Eating, Drinking, or Using Tobacco
violations.observation: A food employee was observed eating, smoking, or drinking in areas where they may contaminate food, clean equipment, utensils or other items needing protection. Observed employee eating lunch over food prep table while consumer food food was being prepared
violations.corrective_action: Food employees may only eat, drink, or use tobacco in a designated area like a dining room or office area. Employees shall not eat or drink in the kitchen areas, warewashing areas, or storage areas where items may become contaminated. PIC stopped employee and had them remove food from food prep area SO GONG DONG TOFU & BBQ (Inspection Date: 11/12/2025) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink at the @LOCATION@ being used @OBSERVATION@. Observed both handwashing sinks in the kitchen being used for storage of soap and water buckets
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. PIC had buckets of soap and water moved from handwashing sinks

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal Foods Different Types
violations.observation: Different types of raw animal foods stored in such a manner that may cause cross contamination as follows: observed raw ground beef being stored over raw fish.
violations.corrective_action: Raw animal foods shall be sorted by their 'type' and cooking temperatures while in storage inside a refrigerator or freezer. For example, if using ONE shelving unit for storage of ONLY raw foods, the foods shall be sorted in this manner: 1) raw poultry (chicken, turkey, or duck) shall be stored on the BOTTOM shelf (165F cook temperature), 2) raw ground beef and ground pork shall be stored on the shelf above poultry (155F cook temperature), and 3) raw pork (chops, ribs), seafood, and shell eggs shall be stored on the top shelf above beef (145F cook temperature). PIC moved raw beef so it not being stored over raw fish

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Restriction & Storage; Medicines Location
violations.observation: Employees' medicines are not properly located to prevent contamination of food and food contact surfaces. Observed ibuprofen, prescription medicine, Advil and various medicines being stored on shelving above food prep surfaces
violations.corrective_action: Employees' medicines shall be properly stored to prevent contamination of food and food contact surfaces. PIC moved medicine away from food contact surfaces

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. Pic moved wiping cloths to buckets of sanitizer

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: observed rice scoops beign stored in standing non heated water
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. PIC removed water and dry stored rice scoops

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, Durable/Smooth Materials
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surface of the following equipment is not corrosion resistant, nonabsorbent, and/or smooth: cardboard was being used as shelf liners in the facility without being changed out every 24 hours
violations.corrective_action: Non-food contact surfaces of equipment that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other foods that require frequent cleaning shall be constructed of a corrosion- resistant, nonabsorbent, and smooth material. PIC agreed to discontinue use of cardboard

violations.title: Cleaning Procedure
violations.observation: EHS observed employee only rinse hands after handling bleach before switching to handling food.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall wash their hands and exposed portions of their arms by: 1) discarding used gloves; 2) rinsing under warm running water; 3) applying soap; 4) rubbing together for at least 10-15 seconds; 5) rinsing thoroughly under warm running water; and 6) drying with paper towels or air drying device. PIC stopped employee and had them properly wash hands before resuming duties.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Restriction & Storage; Medicines Location
violations.observation: Employees' medicines are not properly located to prevent contamination of food and food contact surfaces, employee OTC medicine was being stored on shelves above the food prep surfaces.
violations.corrective_action: Employees' medicines shall be properly stored to prevent contamination of food and food contact surfaces. EHS informed PIC about medicine storage to prevent contamination, PIC had employees remove medicine to personal storage area.

violations.title: Proper thawing methods used for TCS Foods
violations.observation: EHS observed yellow Crocker being thawed on the counter not under running water and outside of refrigeration
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be thawed using one of the following methods: 1) under refrigeration that maintains the food temperature at 41F or less, 2) completely submerged under running water at a water temperature of 70F or below with a sufficient velocity to agitate and float off loose particles of food as long as held for period of time at a temperature of 41F or less, or 3) as part of a cooking process if the food is cooked as specified by Law or thawed in a microwave oven and immediately transferred to a conventional cooking process. EHS informed PIC about proper thawing procedure and PIC moved fish into the 2 door upright cooler to continue thawing process

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: EHS observed kimchi, rice, sauces and other ingredients being stored inside of re-used soy sauce buckets in various fridges around the Kitchen area without common name labels
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. EHS informed PIC that all food needed labels that was not readily identifiable PIC had employees make labels foods

violations.title: Where to Wash
violations.observation: A food employee was observed cleaning their hands in a food preparation sink, warewashing sink or in a mop sink. OBSERVED FOOD EMPLOYEE WASH HANDS IN 3 COMPARTMENT SINK WHEN CHANGING TASKS.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands in ONLY a designated handsink. CFM EDUCATED ALL FOOD EMPLOYEES TO WASH HANDS IN HAND SINK ONLY WHEN CHANGING TASKS.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: OBSERVED HOUSE-MADE KIMCHI CONTAINER KEPT MORE THAN 24 HOURS WITH NO DATE MARKING ON CONTAINER.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. CFM HAD EMPLOYEE DATE MARK KIMCHI CONTAINERS.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: OBSERVED VARIOUS SECONDARY SQUIRT BOTTLES AND CONTAINERS OF SPICES THROUGHOUT KITCHEN WITH NO FOOD NAME MARKED ON CONTAINER.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. CFM HAD EMPLOYEE WRITE FOOD NAME ON ALL CONTAINERS. SO GONG DONG TOFU & BBQ (Inspection Date: 12/20/2024) Page 2 of 3
